thread:
OpsBot: Detected elevated 5xxs and token-level latency for inference in eu-west-1. Auto-alert created.
Samir Patel: Seeing clients in EU reporting multiple slow responses (~2-3s extra per token). Looks like KV cache miss storms.
Priya Shah: Confirmed increased K/V eviction rates on mcache-eu-west-1-*. Metrics: eviction_rate x7, cache_hit_rate down from 98% to 62%.
Jenna Liu: Rolling a mitigation: disable aggressive prefetch and limit concurrent prefixes to 8 for eu-west pools. Patch queued: `service: runtime; config: pref.cache.prefetch=false`
Marco Rivera: Applying patch to blue pool now, canary on pod p-43. Will monitor for 2 mins.
Samir Patel: Notifying CS & SRE on impacted customers list. Tagging @here in infra-notify.
OpsBot: Canary deploy completed on p-43, no regressions.
Jenna Liu: Canary shows hit rate improving to 85%, 5xxs reduced ~60%. Scaling back aggressive batching for affected model families as stopgap.
Priya Shah: Triggered automated fallback routing to companion model variant (quantized) for customers with strict latency SLOs. Fallback ratio currently ~12%.
Marco Rivera: Hotfix deployed to runtime (rev: a1b2c3d) to throttle eviction under write bursts. Rollout to all eu-west nodes started.
Samir Patel: Drafting customer-facing note — will publish to status page after final verification.
StatusBot: Incident page created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1791234567 (summary + affected customers redacted).
Jenna Liu: Short-term mitigations in place. Monitoring: error_rate back down to baseline in 10/12 pools, token latency trending down.
Priya Shah: Next steps: 1) complete full rollout of hotfix, 2) postmortem runbook assignment, 3) follow-up with affected accounts.
Marco Rivera: Full rollout finished at 17:23 UTC. No further increases in eviction rate after rollout.
Samir Patel: Customer-impacting incident — severity S3 -> S2 (transient but customer visible). Will hold update channel open for the hour, then move to postmortem prep.
Priya Shah: Assigned postmortem owner: Jenna Liu. ETA initial draft by EOD tomorrow.
OpsBot: Automation note: Pager suppressed at 17:30 UTC for resolved alerts; will reopen if metrics breach thresholds.
Samir Patel: Final internal status: mitigated, ongoing monitoring, customer comms pending review. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction
StatusBot: Public status update prepared: "Degraded inference performance in eu-west-1 due to cache eviction storm; mitigations applied; service restored for most customers. Full details to follow." Will publish after Samir approval. :white_check_mark:
